ws_1.title: CATALYX Standard Operating Procedure
ws_1.content: This wiki outlines the strict operational guidelines for team compliance. 1. Break tasks into under-30-minute intervals. 2. Lock in streaks proactively. 3. Tag AI Scout for immediate burnout profile analysis.
